name: DequantSwigluQuant

bias.description: shape varies; supports int32; optional, may be None

quant_scale.description: shape varies; supports float32; optional, may be None

quant_offset.description: shape varies; supports float32; optional, may be None

group_index.description: shape varies; supports int64; optional, may be None

description: Fused dequantize + SwiGLU + requantize. torch_npu.npu_dequant_swiglu_quant(x, weight_scale, activation_scale, ...) returns (quantized_output, quant_scales). Dequantize int32 input, apply SwiGLU, requantize to int8.
